post_title: What will be Grupo Casas Bahia's (BHIA3) closing share price on 27 November 2026?

question.title: What will be Grupo Casas Bahia's (BHIA3) closing share price on 27 November 2026?
question.description:
Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. (B3: BHIA3) is one of Brazil's largest household-appliance, electronics and furniture retailers, operating the Casas Bahia and Ponto Frio banners, with 1,033 stores reported as of 30 June 2026 (2Q26 ITR, published 16 August 2026), after the company completed the closure of 298 stores under its store-footprint reduction plan.

The group filed for judicial recovery (recuperação judicial) on 16 August 2026 at the 2nd Bankruptcy and Judicial Recovery Court of São Paulo (2ª Vara de Falências e Recuperações Judiciais da Capital). On 21 October 2026 the court granted processing (deferimento do processamento) for the company and nine other group entities in procedural consolidation, covering declared debt of R$17.3 billion — about R$16.4 billion of it unsecured (quirografário) — owed to roughly 24,950–28,000 creditors. The judicial administrator's monthly activity report disclosed in the week of 9–13 November 2026 showed R$17.2 billion of net revenue and a R$13.7 billion net loss for January–August 2026, with R$14.89 billion of unsecured and R$374.2 million of labour claims. Grupo Casas Bahia has 60 days from the processing decision to file its recovery plan, i.e. around late December 2026, and has hired Camille Faria (Althia Partners), who led Americanas' recovery negotiations, to run creditor talks.

The store-closure story is the most active news thread. Magazine Veja reported on 6 November 2026 that Casas Bahia's revenue was falling and that it was preparing to close roughly 200 more stores, with more than 3,000 layoffs already made. On 9 November 2026 the CVM (Brazil's securities regulator) issued Ofício nº 260/2026/CVM/SEP/GEA-2 asking the company to confirm the report and explain why it had not been treated as a material fact (fato relevante). In its 10 November 2026 response the company said its management had neither decided nor deliberated on store closures, and that third-quarter figures were still being prepared. Third-quarter 2026 results were postponed from 11 November to 10 December 2026.

BHIA3 is a penny stock whose equity is a deeply subordinated residual claim against R$14.9 billion of unsecured debt. It closed at R$0.69 on 13 November 2026 (Yahoo Finance), giving a market capitalisation of about R$690 million; the 52-week range is R$0.34–4.06 and the stock is down roughly 79% over twelve months, with average daily turnover of about R$20 million over the last 30 sessions. Daily moves of several percent are routine, driven by RJ procedural news, creditor negotiations and retail trading conditions; there is no listed options market on BHIA3 from which a price distribution could be read. There is no scheduled Casas Bahia corporate event, court hearing or data release on 26–27 November 2026; 27 November 2026 is Black Friday in Brazil and a normal B3 trading day (20 November was a market holiday), and the next hard catalysts are the 10 December earnings report and the late-December recovery-plan filing.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the closing price of Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. (B3 ticker BHIA3) for the trading session of 27 November 2026, as reported in the "Close" column of the Yahoo Finance historical data page for BHIA3.SA: https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BHIA3.SA/history/. Values are in Brazilian reais, so a close printed as 0.83 in that column resolves as 0.83 (i.e., R$0.83). The price used is the close for that session in the share structure in effect on that date, so if a share grouping (grupamento/reverse split) or comparable share-count-changing corporate action takes effect on or before 27 November 2026, the question resolves to the post-action price displayed for that session. If Yahoo Finance does not display a closing price for that session (for example because trading in BHIA3 was suspended or the exchange was closed), the question resolves to the most recent closing price reported for BHIA3 on or before 27 November 2026. If that Yahoo Finance page is inaccessible or no longer shows historical prices, the B3 official closing price for 27 November 2026 as reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used.
